quests.desc: Welcome to another exciting game of TextWorld! Recover the stick of butter from the shelf.
commands: take stick of butter from shelf
take stick of butter from shelf

quests.desc: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First of all, recover the stick of butter from the shelf within the office. After getting the stick of butter, make an attempt to travel west. And then, make an effort to head south. Then, try to head east. And then, eat the stick of butter. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
commands: take stick of butter from shelf
take stick of butter from shelf

infos.name: chamber
infos.desc:
You arrive in a chamber. A standard kind of place. You decide to start listing off everything you see in the room, as if you were in a text adventure.

 You can see a desk! The desk is usual.[if there is something on the s_1] On the desk you make out [a list of things on the s_1].[end if][if there is nothing on the s_1] But the thing is empty, unfortunately.[end if]

There is an unblocked exit to the east. You don't like doors? Why not try going north, that entranceway is unblocked. There is an exit to the west. Don't worry, it is unguarded.

infos.name: cubicle
infos.desc:
You've entered a cubicle.



You need an unguarded exit? You should try going east. You don't like doors? Why not try going north, that entranceway is unblocked.

infos.name: office
infos.desc:
You are in an office. A standard kind of place.

 You can make out a shelf. [if there is something on the s_0]On the shelf you make out [a list of things on the s_0].[end if][if there is nothing on the s_0]Unfortunately, there isn't a thing on it. You think about smashing the shelf to bits, throwing the bits into the garbage, etc, until you get bored.[end if]

 There is [if d_0 is open]an open[otherwise]a closed[end if] portal leading west. You don't like doors? Why not try going east, that entranceway is unguarded. There is an exit to the north. Don't worry, it is unblocked. There is an unguarded exit to the south.

infos.name: bar
infos.desc:
Well I'll be, you are in a place we're calling a bar.



 There is [if d_0 is open]an open[otherwise]a closed[end if] portal leading east. There is an exit to the north. Don't worry, it is unguarded. You need an unguarded exit? You should try going south.

infos.name: cookery
infos.desc:
You've just sauntered into a cookery.

 You can make out [if c_0 is locked]a locked[else if c_0 is open]an opened[otherwise]a closed[end if] Henderson's safe.[if c_0 is open and there is something in the c_0] The Henderson's safe contains [a list of things in the c_0]. Huh, weird.[end if][if c_0 is open and the c_0 contains nothing] The Henderson's safe is empty, what a horrible day![end if]

There is an unblocked exit to the north. There is an exit to the west. Don't worry, it is unblocked.

infos.name: launderette
infos.desc:
You've just shown up in a launderette. The room seems oddly familiar, as though it were only superficially different from the other rooms in the building.

 You can see a table. [if there is something on the s_2]On the table you see [a list of things on the s_2].[end if][if there is nothing on the s_2]But oh no! there's nothing on this piece of trash.[end if]

You need an unguarded exit? You should try going south. You don't like doors? Why not try going west, that entranceway is unblocked.

infos.name: workshop
infos.desc:
You arrive in a workshop. A normal kind of place.

 Look over there! a American style chest. You can't wait to tell the folks at home about this![if c_1 is open and there is something in the c_1] The American style chest contains [a list of things in the c_1]. You idly wonder how they came up with the name TextWorld for this place. It's pretty fitting.[end if][if c_1 is open and the c_1 contains nothing] The American style chest is empty! This is the worst thing that could possibly happen, ever![end if] You can make out a trunk.[if c_2 is open and there is something in the c_2] The trunk contains [a list of things in the c_2].[end if][if c_2 is open and the c_2 contains nothing] What a letdown! The trunk is empty![end if]

You need an unguarded exit? You should try going south.

infos.name: study
infos.desc:
You arrive in a study. A typical kind of place. You try to gain information on your surroundings by using a technique you call 'looking.'

 You lean against the wall, inadvertently pressing a secret button. The wall opens up to reveal a bookshelf. [if there is something on the s_3]On the bookshelf you make out [a list of things on the s_3].[end if][if there is nothing on the s_3]However, the bookshelf, like an empty bookshelf, has nothing on it. This always happens, here in TextWorld![end if]

There is an unguarded exit to the south.
